Traditional sources affirm Solomon’s construction of the temple in Jerusalem (d5, d7), while alternative theories argue it was an Egyptian temple or that the biblical account misattributes its destruction (d1, d2). Archaeological assessments emphasize the absence of direct material evidence due to the inability to excavate the Temple Mount, which further underscores the uncertainty (d6).
